metadata.title: Quasimorphisms and bounded cohomology of transformation groups of nonorientable surfaces
metadata.abstract: Let $N_g$ be a closed connected nonorientable surface of genus $g\ge1$, let $\omega$ be a smooth positive density, and let $\mu$ be a good measure. In this paper we generalize the Gambaudo--Ghys construction using homogeneous quasimorphisms on the central quotients of the braid groups of $N_g$. We prove injectivity of this map for density-preserving diffeomorphisms. For $g\ge2$ and quasimorphisms vanishing on the disc braid group, we obtain an injective map to $C^0$-continuous homogeneous quasimorphisms on $Homeo_0(N_g,\mu)$. We also obtain undistortion criteria in $Homeo_0(N_g)$ and $Diff_0(N_g)$. For $g=1,2$ and every $d\ge2$, we prove $$ \dim\overline H_b^d(Homeo_0(N_g,\mu))=\infty,\qquad \dim\overline{EH}_b^d(Diff_0(N_g,\omega))=\infty. $$ Moreover, $\overline{EH}_b^d(Homeo_0(N_2,\mu))$ is infinite dimensional in every positive even degree $d$. Here $\overline{H}_b^d$ and $\overline{EH}_b^d$ denote reduced bounded cohomology and reduced exact bounded cohomology, respectively.

analysis.workSummary: 推广Gambaudo–Ghys构造，以曲面辫群中心商的齐次拟同态产生保密度微分同胚群上的单射；g≥2且拟同态在圆盘辫群上消失时，得到保好测度Homeo0上的C⁰连续版本。g=1、2时给出所有d≥2的若干约化有界/正合有界上同调无限维结论，另有Klein瓶Homeo0的正偶数次数结论。
analysis.breakthrough: 将不可定向低属数曲面变换群纳入系统的拟同态和高阶上同调框架。
analysis.limitations: 不同属数、群及次数的结论不完全相同；Homeo版连续性需额外圆盘消失条件，不能概括为所有属数任意次数同一结论。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
